notes:
T772 removes cost from solo model choice and installs the §5 qualification gate (measurement-methodology.md §5) plus the D027 exploration-first least-data tie-break, per the operator's 2026-08-23 ratified direction. soloPick now: (1) drops underqualified candidates regardless of cost; (2) prefers qualified over unmeasured (D027: unmeasured is eligible to try, never preferred over a qualified model); (3) breaks ties on the fewest kanban rows, drawing uniformly among the least-data set. Method is now `solo-least-data` (was `solo-cost`). Cost is REPORTING-only: shape_reasons states it and never decides, and a `trusted:false` retro reading is labelled `(trusted:false retro — reporting only)` so a retro number is never mistaken for a dispatch-time one (T746 ruling 3). The panel path's equal-marginal cost tie-break is likewise replaced by the least-data rule, so cost is removed from model choice everywhere, not just solo.

Fixture control (red before / green after): `test "solo: §5-failing lane is not picked even when cheapest (T772)"` marks a lane underqualified and asserts it is excluded even when its measured cost is the lowest. 6 new solo tests + 1 new panel tie-break test; `zig test src/managent/main.zig` is 43 passed / 3 failed, where the 3 failures are PRE-EXISTING at HEAD (commit 2ec4f93 made ox-alpha appetite SPEND and the T635 roster tests still expect 5 candidates) — outside this row's scope and not touched.

Before/after for the 12 currently-dispatchable solo rows: the method changes solo-cost → solo-least-data on all 12, but the picked model is unchanged (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) because haiku is simultaneously the cheapest AND the least-measured candidate (7 kanban rows vs ox-alpha 8, sonnet 17, opus 20, flash 56, pro 102). The model only changes once a task-type-scoped §5 qualification record is readable by the picker: the fabrication-gate data already exists (`docs/infra/model-task-metrics.jsonl` carries `qualified:false` for haiku/audit `race1-t447-replication` and the T554 spec fabrication is recorded in `docs/infra/model-ladders.md` §spec/design), but the kanban rows carry no task_type and θ/φ are unrecorded (S07 spec LAT-FLAG-5), so the live picker honestly renders every candidate `unmeasured` and reduces to least-data. Follow-up (not this row): wire the §5 record once rows declare a task_type (T750 metric record + S06/S07), at which point haiku drops out of audit/spec rows. No claims proposed and no register rows: this row fixes a picker defect; it asserts nothing about the solver's epistemic register (T806 precedent). Inbox polled empty at claim and before done.
